title: He Paid For A Movie
the_thought: He paid for a movie. He gave it away.
hook: A giant blank prize check is taller than the man in the hoodie.

levels.name: The Short
beats: YouTube is free to watch, but this movie-sized bill is standing in a loading bay. He paid for a movie, then he gave it away. In 2021 he posted a Squid Game field trip with a prize of about 456 thousand. Later writeups put that playground near 3.5 million dollars, and he still put it up for free. Then he built a Greenville lot worth about 14 million, and he slept inside it.
